story_type: hurricane boat crew rescue with babies
hook: Two babies were stuck on a grounded boat in a hurricane.
narration: This baby was stuck on a shrimp boat that ran aground in Hurricane Delta.
Three fishing boats were aground near Rollover Pass, Texas, with four adults, two babies and three dogs.
Nobody had a life jacket, and they feared the boats would roll over.
A boat crew from Coast Guard Station Galveston headed out.
Their boat normally stays in port above thirty knot winds. [short pause] That day the wind was blowing over fifty five.
They pulled up beside the shrimp boat, and its bigger hull blocked some of the wind while people crossed.
A Coast Guard helicopter circled overhead, and rescue swimmers helped on the shrimp boat.
Everyone crossed onto the Coast Guard boat in the rain.
outcome: The Galveston crew brought all four adults, both babies and all three dogs off those boats.
title: Two babies stranded in Hurricane Delta
description:
A Coast Guard Station Galveston boat crew rescued four adults, two infants and three dogs from fishing vessels aground near Rollover Pass in Gilchrist, Texas, during Hurricane Delta on Oct. 9, 2020.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Ryan Dickinson, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/777247/coast-guard-rescues-6-people-grounded-vessels-near-rollover-pass-gilchrist-texas
